verdict.rationale: AskFred is Fireflies' own natural-language assistant: you can ask questions about one meeting or many, and follow-ups keep their context. Fireflies' official MCP server also exposes action tools (share, move, soundbite) that AI clients can call from natural-language prompts. However, the native natural-language interface is documented only for querying, and acting on the product through language relies on external AI clients. missing for 10: documented native natural-language commands that perform actions (e.g. sharing or organizing meetings from AskFred), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.
